jobs.title: Senior Creative Concepter & Strategist (Mensch)
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das Bieten Wir Dir

Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das Bewegst Du

Als Senior
Creative Concepter & Strategist mit Fokus Influencer & Organic Social
bist du unser kreativer Kopf und strategischer Impulsgeber. Du übernimmst die inhaltliche Führung bei der Entwicklung von Creator-getriebenen Konzepten & Strategien

Deine Mission: Kreative Exzellenz mit Influencer- & Social-DNA!

Synergie aus Influence & Media: Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung kulturell relevanter Kampagnen und Plattform-Konzepte. Du verbindest packendes Creator-Storytelling mit strategischer Mediaplanung und stehst im engen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen aus der Media und dem Influencer Management.
Konzeption & Strategie: Von der ersten Trend-Idee über das Creator-Briefing bis hin zum fertigen Organic-Social-Format – du übernimmst die konzeptionelle und strategische Führung deiner Projekte und sorgst für Konsistenz und Exzellenz im Output.
Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Expert:innen aus Social Media, Influencer Marketing, Brand Experience und Media, um ganzheitliche und wirkungsvolle Brand-Erlebnisse zu schaffen.
Kunden, Pitches & Storytelling: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte strategisch, arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement zusammen und präsentierst deine Ideen & Strategien souverän bei Pitches, Workshops und Kundenterminen.
Mentoring & Team-Spirit: Du teilst dein Wissen rund um Creator Culture, Trends und Social Strategy proaktiv mit unseren Talenten – von Mid-Level bis zu Werkstudierenden – und entwickelst das Team gemeinsam weiter.

Das Zeichnet Dich Aus

Trend- & Creator-Gespür: Du lebst Social Media (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Co.), verstehst Creator-Culture sowie Plattform-Mechaniken im Schlaf und hast Lust, KI-Tools und neue Formate aktiv auszuprobieren.
Deine Erfahrung: Ideal sind 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Influencer Marketing, Social Strategy, Konzeption oder Copywriting (bevorzugt im Agenturumfeld). Du weißt, wie man Stories schreibt, die sowohl Creators als auch Zielgruppen begeistern, und bringst idealerweise auch Dreherfahrung mit.
Dein Mindset: Du bist eigeninitiativ, strategisch denkend, verantwortungsbewusst und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
Deine Skills: Du präsentierst und argumentierst stark auf Deutsch (mind. C1) sowie sehr gut auf Englisch.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamplayer #motiviert #neugierig

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten Bei WPP Media

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
We're hiring: Creative Director | Dubai | Full-time

TACTECH New Media
is a Dubai-based creative technology studio working where storytelling, design and technology meet. We create immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, brand campaigns and content for opening ceremonies and shows.

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative vision from first insight to final execution.

THE ROLE

Lead TACTECH's creative direction across immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, opening ceremonies, shows and campaigns. Bring the strategic thinking and conceptual discipline of an experienced agency creative leader to every brief, whether or not it is a campaign. Guide ideas from insight and concept through narrative, audience experience, visual development and final execution, in close collaboration with production and technology teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative strategy and concept leadership

Interpret client and agency briefs, uncover audience and business objectives, and establish a clear strategic creative rationale.
Develop original concepts, storylines, scripts, experience narratives, visitor journeys, creative treatments and presentations for corporate and entertainment projects.
Bring proven campaign thinking - audience insight, big ideas, messaging and consistency across touchpoints - to campaign assignments and apply that same strategic rigor to TACTECH's wider creative work.
Shape UX scripts, user flows and screen-by-screen interactions with designers and developers; define participation or game mechanics only when they add value to a relevant experience.

Art direction and content direction

Direct key visuals, styleframes, storyboards, moodboards, design systems, animation language and presentation materials across content, campaigns and experiences.
Guide creative storytelling and execution for corporate films, opening films, footage-led content, CGI, motion graphics, AI-assisted visuals and relevant live-action productions.
Shape how stories unfold across immersive and large-format screens, opening ceremonies, show sequences and interactive applications, choosing techniques for their creative value.
Protect brand accuracy, typography, visual hierarchy, narrative clarity and consistent creative quality from early concepts through final output.

Creative team leadership and integration

Brief, mentor and review the Art Director, designers, motion artists, and external creative specialists, providing clear and actionable feedback.
Work with the Production Manager to define creative disciplines, resource needs, quality benchmarks and review checkpoints; collaborate with Producers, Technology and Technical Leads to test feasibility early.
Continuously review freelance artists' portfolios, assess creative capabilities and recommend the right specialists for each assignment in coordination with production.
Use AI creative tools proficiently to visualize and communicate ideas through concepts, visual references, styleframes, storyboards and previsualization, while maintaining high creative standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

10+ years of creative experience, including a strong agency background with hands-on campaign concept development and senior creative leadership across experiential, digital, motion/CGI or content work.
A portfolio demonstrating personal ownership of strategy, concepts and finished work across corporate and entertainment assignments, including campaign work as well as content or experiences.
Strong strategic and conceptual judgment, storytelling and script/treatment skills, and the ability to turn complex briefs into distinctive ideas and audience experiences.
Working knowledge of interactive UX and occasional gamified experiences, animation, CGI, screen content and practical physical-digital production constraints.
Confident creative presentation, multidisciplinary team leadership and a collaborative approach to resource and technical feasibility planning.
Hands-on proficiency with contemporary AI-assisted creative tools, with strong judgment about quality, originality and practical application.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Creative ideas demonstrate audience understanding, strategic relevance and originality, whatever the format or channel.
Stories, art direction, UX intent and relevant interaction mechanics translate coherently from creative pitch through implementation.
Internal and external creative teams receive clear briefs, useful reviews and timely decisions; specialists are well matched to projects.
The work demonstrates strong craft and feasibility, strengthens client confidence and elevates the studio portfolio.

ROLE BOUNDARIES AND COLLABORATION

Reporting line:
Managing Director
This is not a film-only director, conventional advertising art director, event-design/fabrication or game-studio position. TACTECH creates strategy-informed concepts, content and technology-led experiences; event operations and physical fabrication, when needed, are handled with specialist partners.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit a CV and a curated portfolio of 4-6 projects showing creative strategy or rationale, your personal concept contribution, the disciplines involved and the finished outcome. Include campaign work and relevant examples across content, immersive/interactive, corporate or entertainment projects.
Apply through the job post or send a direct email to : careers@tactech.digital

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
An established UAE-based healthcare and wellness distribution company is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist
to design, execute, and optimise digital media strategies across a diverse portfolio of international product brands.
This role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, focusing on building brand visibility, reaching the right consumers, driving engagement, and converting digital marketing investments into measurable commercial results.
You will work closely with Brand Management, Sales, E-commerce, and external partners to develop brand-specific digital strategies aligned with commercial objectives, product launches, consumer behaviour, and market opportunities.

What You Will Own

Brand Digital Strategy:
Design and execute digital media strategies for individual product brands, translating brand positioning, target audiences, and commercial priorities into actionable plans.
Media Planning & Budgeting:
Develop digital media plans, recommend channel investments, allocate approved budgets, and monitor spending effectiveness across brands.
Paid Media & Campaign Management:
Plan, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other relevant digital platforms.
Performance Marketing:
Improve campaign effectiveness through audience targeting, bidding strategies, A/B testing, remarketing, and conversion optimisation.
SEO & SEM:
Develop and implement search strategies that strengthen product visibility, generate qualified traffic, and support customer acquisition.
Analytics & Reporting:
Analyse performance using GA4, Meta Insights, and other reporting tools, measuring reach, engagement, conversions, customer acquisition costs, and ROI.
Brand Content & Social Media:
Develop brand-specific digital content plans, coordinate creative production, and ensure consistency across digital platforms.
CRM & Consumer Engagement:
Support targeted email campaigns, audience segmentation, customer journeys, and marketing automation initiatives.
Influencer & Digital Partnerships:
Coordinate influencer campaigns and digital collaborations, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and measurable outcomes.
E-commerce Integration:
Work with e-commerce teams to drive traffic, improve conversion rates, and support online sales through effective digital campaigns.
Innovation & Optimisation:
Identify emerging digital trends, AI-powered tools, and automation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and effectiveness.
Compliance:
Ensure digital campaigns, advertising claims, and creative materials comply with applicable regulations and brand guidelines.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You can independently develop a digital media strategy and take ownership of its execution.
You understand how to adapt digital strategies to different brands, consumer segments, and commercial objectives.
You have personally managed advertising campaigns and digital media budgets.
You know how to translate performance data into practical decisions that improve campaign results.
You are commercially minded and understand how digital marketing supports brand growth and sales.
You combine creativity, analytical thinking, and hands-on execution.
You can effectively manage multiple brands, campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines.

Must Have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications, or a related discipline.
5–7 years of progressive experience in digital marketing
, preferably in healthcare, nutraceuticals, wellness, consumer health, or FMCG.
Proven experience developing and executing digital media strategies across multiple brands or product categories.
Hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, paid social advertising, SEO, and SEM.
Demonstrated experience managing digital media budgets and optimising campaign performance.
Strong proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), digital performance reporting, and conversion analysis.
Experience with audience segmentation, remarketing, A/B testing, and customer acquisition strategies.
Working knowledge of CRM, email marketing, and automation platforms.
Strong analytical, project management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Nice to Have

Experience managing digital campaigns for healthcare, nutraceutical, wellness, or other regulated consumer products.
Exposure to e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Noon, or Shopify.
Certifications in Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, HubSpot, or SEO.
Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
Experience using AI-powered marketing and automation solutions.

Interested?

If you can combine digital strategy, creative thinking, and performance marketing to deliver measurable brand growth, we would like to hear from you.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Candidates who can demonstrate successful digital media strategies, campaign results, and measurable business impact will be particularly encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Our Role

Reporting to the Senior Creative Producer, the Creative Shoot Producer will work across the production and delivery of inspiring stills and video across campaign, print, digital, social and e-commerce channels, with particular responsibility for casting and video post-production.

You will oversee shoots from brief to final delivery, ensuring every asset reflects The White Company’s distinctive aesthetic and connects with our customer. With a strong eye for fashion and talent, you will translate creative direction into thoughtful casting and well-planned productions that bring our collections to life.

You will build relationships with model agencies, photographers, fashion stylists, directors, DOPs, editors and post-production partners. Working closely with Art Direction, Creative and Marketing, you will manage budgets, schedules and approvals, ensuring stills and moving image are considered together from the outset.

Highly organised and commercially astute, you will combine confident talent negotiation with a detailed understanding of both stills and video workflows, guiding projects through to delivery while maintaining creative quality and brand consistency.

What you'll be doing

Main duties include, but are not limited to:

Partner with Buying & Merchandising, Marketing and Creative to define seasonal campaign asset requirements and develop production plans, shot lists and detailed budgets for approval.
Manage pre-production, on-set production and logistics for UK and overseas shoots. Book creative teams, locations, studios and travel; manage call sheets, shoot schedules, samples and outfittings with relevant teams.
Plan stills and motion shoot schedules. Work with Art Direction, Styling, hair and make-up, photographers and DOPs to deliver the brief.
Manage casting for seasonal campaigns, e-commerce, social and video, translating creative briefs into clear talent requirements that reflect the brand, customer and collection.
Research emerging and established models and talent; build agency relationships and present considered shortlists with portfolios, digitals and movement references where relevant.
Negotiate fees and usage across agreed channels, territories and durations. Manage supplier costs and reconciliations; flag risks early, oversee stills post-production.
Support junior production and shoot assistant colleagues to deliver consistently high standards.
Manage video post-production schedules and budgets, agreeing deliverables, edit milestones, review rounds and final delivery dates before each shoot.
Manage video editors, colourists, and sound specialist partners. Consolidate stakeholder feedback and secure approvals at each stage.
Oversee hero films, cutdowns and channel-specific versions, checking aspect ratios, durations, audio, captions and export specifications before delivery; deliver approved assets with accurate naming, version control and metadata to the DAM system.

The Skills & Experience That You’ll Need

Significant relevant production experience, ideally within fashion, retail or editorial, delivering stills and video from brief to final asset.
A strong visual eye and clear understanding of photography, styling, composition and brand storytelling.
Proven casting experience and established relationships with model agencies and creative talent, and confidence negotiating talent fees, usage rights and supplier contracts.
Substantial experience managing video post-production, including edit briefs, schedules, review rounds, grading, sound, graphics, captions and final delivery.
Proven ability to manage multiple productions, detailed budgets and competing deadlines, keeping stakeholders informed and approvals on track.
Excellent attention to detail, clear communication and a practical approach to solving problems; comfortable working independently and collaboratively, and supporting junior colleagues

What we’ll offer you

At The White Company, we value our employees for always going the extra mile for every one of our customers; we reward this with great benefits and competitive salaries.

Discount -Up to 50% discount and access to regular Sample Sales
Holiday - 25 days rising to 28 with length of service
Holiday Buy – opportunity to buy up to 5 days holiday
Pension Scheme - enrolled in our Group Personal Pension schemes upon joining the business.
Bonus - In addition to our competitive salaries, all our employees are entitled to join a discretionary bonus scheme (based on policy eligibility)

jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does Creative Technologist do at WPP Production?

A Creative Technologist at WPP Production is positioned at the crossroads of creativity and technology. Their primary role is to harness cutting-edge technological advancements to enhance and actualise creative visions. In collaboration with the Marketing Transformation Team, as well as with designers, developers, and other stakeholders, they ensure that tech-driven solutions are utilized to amplify the essence of creative content and effectively address client requirements. Essentially, a Creative Technologist integrates innovative technological tools and methods with artistic concepts, ensuring that the end product is both technologically advanced and creatively compelling within the framework of WPP Production's commitment to delivering superior content experiences. This role has a strong focus on AI.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to ideate, design, and developvisually stunning projects using a mix of AI, 3D, and retouching techniques.
Harness the power of AI image generation tools to create innovative visualsfor various campaigns and products.
Design, model, and render 3D assets that can be integrated with AI-generated imagery or used independently.
Expertly retouch and enhance photos, ensuring they meet the highest quality standards for both print and digital platforms.
Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI image generation, 3D design, and retouching techniques to ensure cutting-edge output.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
Troubleshoot technical issues related to visual projects and provide solutions.
Stable Diffusion - highly desirable

Requirements

AI Image Generation: Experience with AI-based image generation tools and platforms, with an understanding of underlying algorithms.
3D Expertise: Proficiency in industry-leading 3D software like Blender, Maya,or Cinema 4D.
Retouching Skills: Mastery in retouching using software such as AdobePhotoshop, with a keen eye for detail.
Innovation: A knack for conceptualizing and executing visually compelling solutions by combining AI, 3D, and retouching techniques.
Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work seamlessly with designers, developers, and other stakeholders.
Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying updated with the ever-evolving fields of AI, 3D
Stable Diffusion - highly desirable

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

jobs.title: Creative Concepter & Strategist (Mensch)
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das Bieten Wir Dir

Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das Bewegst Du

Als Creative Concepter & Strategist mit Fokus Influencer & Organic Social
bist du unser kreativer Kopf und strategischer Impulsgeber. Du übernimmst die inhaltliche Führung bei der Entwicklung von Creator-getriebenen Konzepten & Strategien

Deine Mission: Kreative Exzellenz mit Influencer- & Social-DNA!

Synergie aus Influence & Media: Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung kulturell relevanter Kampagnen und Plattform-Konzepte. Du verbindest packendes Creator-Storytelling mit strategischer Mediaplanung und stehst im engen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen aus der Media und dem Influencer Management.
Konzeption & Strategie: Von der ersten Trend-Idee über das Creator-Briefing bis hin zum fertigen Organic-Social-Format – du übernimmst die konzeptionelle und strategische Führung deiner Projekte und sorgst für Konsistenz und Exzellenz im Output.
Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Expert:innen aus Social Media, Influencer Marketing, Brand Experience und Media, um ganzheitliche und wirkungsvolle Brand-Erlebnisse zu schaffen.
Kunden, Pitches & Storytelling: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte strategisch, arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement zusammen und präsentierst deine Ideen & Strategien souverän bei Pitches, Workshops und Kundenterminen.
Mentoring & Team-Spirit: Du teilst dein Wissen rund um Creator Culture, Trends und Social Strategy proaktiv mit unseren Talenten – von Mid-Level bis zu Werkstudierenden – und entwickelst das Team gemeinsam weiter.

Das Zeichnet Dich Aus

Trend- & Creator-Gespür: Du lebst Social Media (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Co.), verstehst Creator-Culture sowie Plattform-Mechaniken im Schlaf und hast Lust, KI-Tools und neue Formate aktiv auszuprobieren.
Deine Erfahrung: Ideal sind 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Influencer Marketing, Social Strategy, Konzeption oder Copywriting (bevorzugt im Agenturumfeld). Du weißt, wie man Stories schreibt, die sowohl Creators als auch Zielgruppen begeistern, und bringst idealerweise auch Dreherfahrung mit.
Dein Mindset: Du bist eigeninitiativ, strategisch denkend, verantwortungsbewusst und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
Deine Skills: Du präsentierst und argumentierst stark auf Deutsch (mind. C1) sowie sehr gut auf Englisch.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamplayer #motiviert #neugierig

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten Bei WPP Media

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

Du hast ein starkes kreatives und visuelles Verständnis und Erfahrung darin, Produktionen innerhalb einer bestehenden Markenidentität eigenständig vom Briefing bis zur finalen Ausspielung zu steuern.
Du kennst die Anforderungen von E-Commerce Content und digitalen Formaten und bringst Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Produktionsteams, externen Partnern, Budgets und Ressourcen mit.
Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei wechselnden Prioritäten den Überblick.
Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, kennst die relevanten Themen rund um Copyright und Nutzungsrechte und bist neugierig auf AI, Automatisierung und neue Produktionstechnologien.

Ein spannender Job. Und Benefits, die überzeugen.

Ein Obstkorb, gratis Kaffee, Tee, Kaltgetränke und eine gute Kantine sind längst Standard, gehören aber selbstverständlich zu unserem umfangreichen Benefit-Paket. Und das ist noch längst nicht alles.

Für die Erholung: neben 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr erwarten Dich im siebten Jahr zusätzlich vier Wochen bezahlter Sonderurlaub (Sabbatical)
Für die Zukunft: profitiere von unserer cosnovAcademy mit einem umfangreichen Weiterbildungsangebot
Für das Büro: es erwarten Dich ein modernes, stylisches Büro, gratis Mittagessen am Montag und Freitag sowie kostenfreie Tiefgaragenparkplätze
Für jede Lebenslage: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, inhouse Fitnessstudio, Job Ticket, Zuschuss zu Kinderbetreuungskosten und viele gemeinsame Events. Unsere Liste ist lang, da ist bestimmt auch etwas für Dich dabei.

Alle unsere Benefits findest Du hier: www.cosnova.com/de/karriere

is a Dubai-based creative technology studio working where storytelling, design and technology meet. We create immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, brand campaigns and content for opening ceremonies and shows.

Lead TACTECH's creative direction across immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, opening ceremonies, shows and campaigns. Creative strategy and concept leadership

Develop original concepts, storylines, scripts, experience narratives, visitor journeys, creative treatments and presentations for corporate and entertainment projects.
Bring proven campaign thinking - audience insight, big ideas, messaging and consistency across touchpoints - to campaign assignments and apply that same strategic rigor to TACTECH's wider creative work.
Shape UX scripts, user flows and screen-by-screen interactions with designers and developers; define participation or game mechanics only when they add value to a relevant experience.

Art direction and content direction

Creative team leadership and integration

Use AI creative tools proficiently to visualize and communicate ideas through concepts, visual references, styleframes, storyboards and previsualization, while maintaining high creative standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

Creative ideas demonstrate audience understanding, strategic relevance and originality, whatever the format or channel.

Managing Director
This is not a film-only director, conventional advertising art director, event-design/fabrication or game-studio position. TACTECH creates strategy-informed concepts, content and technology-led experiences; event operations and physical fabrication, when needed, are handled with specialist partners.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s Brand Innovation Lab is looking for a talented, passionate, and a hands-on Creative (Art Director) to conceptualise and create one-of-a-kind campaigns for a wide range of brands across MENA. You’ll partner with Sales leads, Solutions Managers, Producers, and Design Technology and Engineering teams to create first-class customer experiences both online and offline by innovating with the Amazon canvas (Prime Video, Alexa, Twitch, etc.). You’ll lead projects and own client relationships, focusing on creating work that benefits the end customer while pushing the creative envelope from brief to execution, with a focus on our partnerships and sponsorships offering.

From ideation through launch, you will be responsible for delivering ambitious, insightful, and data-driven concepts that translate needs and constraints into customer-focused brand campaign ideas and solutions. You will be equally strong at concept and execution and an expert in leveraging AI tools and workflows, articulating end-to-end creative solutions, and turning that vision into high-quality experiences. This could include video content, user interface designs for voice and screen, interaction models, prototypes, and interactive advertising campaigns. This role will use data and insights to create campaign strategy and concepts, develop designs and the look and feel for experiences, as well as templates for never-before-done brand campaigns and experiences that will solve customer problems, on and off Amazon platforms.

Candidates should have an in-depth understanding of AI tools, Photoshop, Illustrator, PowerPoint, Figma and Webflow, (or an interest to learn Webflow), and understanding of UX design.

The candidate’s portfolio should feature highly creative, award-winning campaigns and ideas that solve customer and advertiser problems through a variety of different media channels, including but not limited to video, social, digital activations, and outdoor. You have strong conceptual, presentation, storytelling, and time management skills, as well as digital media experience, insight-driven and strategic thinking, and of course, an acute attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Concept, design (art), and execute innovative ad campaigns and experiences for global brands.

Partner with designers, program managers, developers, strategists, business leads, and producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on advertiser objectives.

Independently lead campaigns from brief to execution and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners.
Obsessed with understanding customers and making work that delivers both innovation and results.
Present ideas and concepts to clients, agencies, and internally.
Proven ability to ideate for film, print, digital, out-of-home, experiential, and social.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once within budget and deadlines.
Be proactive in developing new products and ideas on behalf of the customer.

A day in the life

Partnering with a variety of brands, media, and creative agencies to work on innovative campaigns for travel and tourism, automotive, finance, consumables, telecommunication etc.
From designing brand experiences (digital and physical), from documentary films in Prime Video to Alexa branded experiences, you will always strive to create never-before-done ideas.
Presenting a campaign to senior brand clients and their partners in creative and media agencies.
Reviewing edits and work in progress with your partners, collecting and responding to feedback in order to meet the highest creative standards.
Work with your team on proactive projects and initiatives and bring them to life.

About The Team

The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team also works on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
In-depth understanding of industry design tools (Ex. Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma), and a basic understanding of UX design and UX design Tools (ie. Webflow)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Experience in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns for brand partnerships and/or sponsorships

Company Description

At Saatchi & Saatchi Health, we believe in making the impossible possible in health. We partner with our clients to turn complexity into clarity, ideas into impact, and ambition into real-world outcomes. By combining creativity, data, and technology, we create work that doesn’t just reach people--it moves them, connects with them, and makes a difference in their lives. Because when our people bring curiosity and courage to the work, we unlock new possibilities for our clients, and better outcomes for the patients they serve. We’re here to push what health can be. And to make it matter.

Overview

The Associate Creative Director (art) is involved in the development of creative concepts, working with all disciplines in the agency including copywriters and designers to build cohesive and effective campaigns.

Their focus is on the visual design and art direction of advertising campaigns. They ensure the visual design aligns with the overall creative direction and strategy of the campaign, and that it effectively communicates the desired message to the target audience.

As a close ally of the Creative Director, they are stepping into a managerial role to mentor team members, especially art directors and designers. In addition, they oversee the production of the visual elements of the campaign, ensuring they are executed to the highest standards.

The Associate Creative Director, Art is responsible for leading the creative work. This leadership role includes assigning teams, inspiring those teams to consistently produce exceptional concepts and final work, and working closely with account management to ensure that our clients are satisfied with the quality of our creative work.

Works with the Creative Director to address performance, workflow, and quality issues and develop long-range plans for the team.
Helps develop and review creative briefs that provide strategic insight(s) and creative inspiration
Promote a culture of creative quality and accountability and ensure creative deliverables meet both our clients’ expectations and our own standards of excellence

People & Leadership *

Is able to proactively raise issues to improve effective team working and collaboration.
Is able to communicate confidently in a clear, concise and articulate manner.
Collaborates with stakeholders and embraces an inclusive based environment.

Able to build relationships quickly with others and engages personally with peers and clients.
Treats others with respect, listens to other perspectives, especially when they are different from own.
Able to tackle problems in a timely manner and develop contingency plans that focus on problem resolution.
Drives a culture of trust with Peers, clients and all other stakeholders.

Innovative & Analytical Mindset *

Develops and reviews creative briefs that provide strategic insight(s) and creative inspiration
Demonstrates to clients that an understanding of their marketing challenges and is responsive to their strategic needs in proposing creative solutions.

Trains new employees on responsibilities and agency procedures, and works with current creative staff to help them achieve professional and personal goals.
Works with the upper management team to plan and pursue continuing strategic growth of agency billings and participate in new business pitch opportunities.
Develops and evaluates creative concepts, copy and art, at pre-determined points and providing direction prior to review by account management.
Sets high creative standards that lead to a body of work that creates enthusiastic customers and clients, and is consistently recognized by agency management as on strategy and unique.
Leads the creative efforts on new business assignments, as needed.
Ensures that creative presentations to the client meet the highest professional standards.
Manages the workload for assigned book of business to maximize the productivity and quality of work from the creative staff.
Imparts outdoor industry expertise and experience to the team.
Conceives and create experience design solutions that meet client objectives
Effectively communicate creative concepts and strategies to both clients and our internal team.
Designing comps, storyboards, initial graphic concepts, and final deliverables
Brainstorms and developing campaigns while working with clients on multiple projects at once
Assists the Creative Director to improve the Creative group’s technical and creative performance.
Help ensure that deadlines and budgets are met.
Ideates, writes and executes original and iconic creative concepts in response to client briefs, objectives or goals.
Extends client relationships and explore new ways to deliver value.
Presents, shares and reviews creative work with Executive Creative Director/s, Account Management and Planning Leads as well as members of the Management Team
